text:
anna: quick heads-up — after landing the kernel-selection change that enables fused-attn on xG1s, staging perf runs show p99 spikes (and a small throughput drop). can we triage?

diego: can you paste the numbers and the exact run id/command to reproduce? p50/p95/p99 + throughput pls.

anna: baseline (old kernels): p50=24ms p95=48ms p99=85ms tps=450
new (fused-attn): p50=22ms p95=50ms p99=210ms tps=412
run id: perf/2026-02-06/0743
command used: `./bench_runner --model redwood-v2 --replicas 8 --batching auto --seq_len 2048 --profile perf/2026-02-06/0743`

mira: timeline note: we changed kernel selector heuristics to prefer fused-attn for seq_len >= 512 and odd-multiple padding removed. could be an edge-case in kernel fallback path + cache alignment. also the p99 jump is huge — check ECDF / histogram, not just single percentile.

perf-bot: alert: perf/regression detected perf/2026-02-06/0743 (p99 +145ms, throughput -8%). linked artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/perf-2026-02-06-0743.tar.gz

kevin: repro tip: run with --raw-latencies and --save-traces, example: ```./bench_runner --model redwood-v2 --replicas 8 --batching auto --seq_len 2048 --warmup 200 --iters 2000 --raw-latencies out.csv --save-traces traces.json --kernel-selector fused````
that will give per-request latencies + trace ids.

anna: pasted a short log snippet where we see a few 700ms tail spikes with stack: `kernel_dispatch -> fused_attn_launch -> cudaMemcpyAsync -> stream_sync`
looks like occasional stream syncs. also saw entries: `kernel-fallback: generic_attn` right before big spikes.

mira: checklist for triage: 1) histogram of raw latencies (ECDF) 2) correlate traces with kernel-fallback logs 3) check batching distribution (are some large single-item batches happening?) 4) tokenization/seq_len distribution (maybe odd lengths trigger padding + fallback) 5) KV-cache miss patterns 6) compare numeric outputs on golden prompts to rule out correctness/regression.

diego: I ran quick A/B locally with synthetic trace of 10k reqs: when I force odd seq lengths near 1025-1031, p99 spikes reproduced. even lengths looked fine. suspect alignment in fused kernel for >1024.

kevin: can we add a guard in selector: avoid fused-attn for seq_len in (1025..2048) for now and roll 5% A/B to measure? routing config: `redwood rollout set model:redwood-v2 selector.override.seq_len_blacklist=1025-2048 --traffic 5%`

anna: I tried disabling batching (single-item) on staging and the p99 still spikes (p50/p95 nearly same). seems not just batching. numbers: single-item new kernel p99=195ms

sre-oncall: any user-facing impact? are production SLOs hitting?

anna: no active customer incidents, only synthetic SLO checks and internal canaries failing — we should treat as high-priority for correctness and perf SLA though.

mira: also run a correctness diff: golden set of 40 prompts (few-shot + long context). compare token-level outputs with tolerance 1e-4 for logits and exact string match for tokens after detokenization. if numerical nondeterminism suspected, run with deterministic kernels.

kevin: plan proposal: 1) add seq_len blacklist guard in kernel selector (temporary) 2) collect full raw latency histograms + traces for the flagged window 3) perf team to debug fused-attn alignment and stream syncs 4) run golden correctness suite on staging with fused/kernel-deterministic builds 5) A/B 5% traffic after green checks. can someone own steps 1-3?

anna: I'll own 1 + collecting traces today. I'll post artifacts to perf S3 and update the perf ticket.

mira: I'll take kernel debug (2/3) and look at cuda kernels and alignment math.

diego: I'll run extended golden diffs and sanity check tokenization edge cases.

kevin: once you have traces, I can set the rollout override and start 5% test.

anna: thanks — uploading traces now. link: s3://redwood-perf/triage/1759601234/

mira: next follow-ups: add ECDF plots to perf dashboards, store raw latency arrays per-run for easier bootstrapping CI. also add a tiny smoke on deploy to detect stream_sync regressions.

perf-bot: note: ticket perf-4521 created for this triage (https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PERF-4521)

sre-oncall: :thumbsup: keep me posted if this spills into prod.

anna: thanks all :thumbsup:
